scope: Artifact-build evidence for the first R09 acquisition obligation.
boundary: A built and internally accepted pre-release package is not an acquisition release. Checkout, payment, order records, receipts, signed delivery, redelivery, refunds, support operations, and production purchase tests remain unimplemented, so public acquisition stays unavailable.

specificAcceptanceTests: Build the worked example from an empty directory using only the package instructions.
Validate all example records against the supplied JSON schemas.
Trace every generated example claim to a source and approval record.
Confirm the 20 promised prompts and all five domains are present and indexed.
artifacts.deferredReason: Universal tests 5–7 require the shared checkout, order, fulfillment, failure, redelivery, refund, supersession, and public-copy infrastructure assigned to a later R09 unit.
releaseBlockers: commercial terms and final license execution
redelivery, expiry, refund, and revocation behavior
operational support channel and response target
